==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Fengbai:''' {{Rover}}, long time no see.
:'''Fengbai:''' Since the last time you wiped out that scamming red-clothed group, security around here has improved a lot.
:'''Fengbai:''' Nearby Exiles have become friendlier too, not causing much trouble.
:'''Fengbai:''' After the situation here calmed down, Mr. Minghu applied for a transfer to an area with poor security.
:'''Fengbai:''' Now, he's probably doing another undercover mission somewhere... Hehe, Mr. Minghu can never stand an idle life.
:'''Fengbai:''' Well, the anti-fraud campaigns have been going very smoothly, and more and more people are participating.
:'''Fengbai:''' Everything has become better, and you have a share of the credit in that.
:'''Fengbai:''' Though it's been a while, I still want to say thank you again.
{{Dialogue End}}
